bays.restriction: Controlled Parking Zone — permit bays plus shared-use pay-by-phone / pay & display bays
bays.times: 8.00 am - 6.30 pm Mon. - Sat. On event days 8am - Bank holidays: restrictions apply on all bank holidays.
bays.max_stay: 2 hours in shared-use bays under the current zone orders; some pay & display bays allow up to 4 hours — check the bay sign
bays.tariff: Borough-uniform short-stay tariff — pay by phone (RingGo): 20p per 6 minutes (stays up to 15 minutes charged at 20p), £1 for 30 minutes, £2 for 1 hour, £4 for 2 hours, £6 for 3 hours, £8 for 4 hours. Pay & display machines: 20p per 6 minutes, £1.50/30 min, £2.50/1 hr, £4.50/2 hrs, plus a 50p surcharge for cash payments (except the 20p short stay)
bays.pay: Pay by phone via RingGo (app, or Call to Park 0203 046 0010) or at pay & display machines (coins/card; +50p cash surcharge) Brent's map data gives RingGo reference 47851 for this zone; the bay sign shows the code to quote.
